Pharmacopoeias. In USNF. USNF 26 (Sucralose). A white to off-white, crystalline powder. Freely soluble in water, in alcohol, and in methyl alcohol; slight- ly soluble in ethyl acetate. Store in a cool, dry place at a temper- ature not exceeding 21°. Profile Sucralose is used as a sweetening agent in foods, beverages, and pharmaceuticals. It has between about 300 and 1000 times the sweetening power of sucrose and is stable to heat. It has no food value and is noncariogenic. ◊ References. 1. Anonymous.
